_note: Scenario parameters are PLACEHOLDERS from public press/encyclopaedic sources (rounded). Replace lat/lon/depth/mag with the Institute's verified catalogue (checklist item B2/B3) and set verified=true before using the maps for anything official. City bboxes enclose the 20 stations with a margin; adjust to the official study boundary. strike_deg: assumed fault strike (Lai Chau-Dien Bien fault ~NNE 20 deg; Son La / Song Ma system ~NW-SE 310-315 deg); M>=6 scenarios use a finite vertical fault (Wells & Coppersmith 1994 dimensions) centred on the epicentre. Verify strikes with the Institute.
